title: Second Certificate in Implant Dentistry - The European Association for Osseointegration
html:
The EAO Second Certificate is our advanced level certificate covering more complex techniques including prosthetics, soft tissue augmentation around implants and immediate implant placement. 

Access wherever you are in the world with a fully online programme developed and led by our expert faculty. The EAO Certificates offer complete flexibility and convenience, allowing you to learn at your own pace at a time that suits you.  

The EAO Second Certificate is available in 10 languages – Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish and Turkish.

Starting in June 2027
